text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: H-El-Lo. I am... Fenomeno—

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text:
"'Today, I'd like to introduce everyone to 
the Umamusume who helped me grow.'"

text_block_list.name: @MenoMenon
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, Fenomeno's official account posted 
again! Yay~~!"

text_block_list.name: @Car♪rot♪
text_block_list.text:
"Helping Fenomeno grow... that means it 
has to be a very earnest Umamusume! It 
must be Eishin Flash!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Meeting Flash-san certainly helped me 
grow as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Every single existence was necessary 
for me to reach where I am today. ...—

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text:
"That would be everyone I have met through 
racing."

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text:
"Among them, Gold Ship, who ran alongside 
him since the Classic stage—"

I meet up with Fenomeno, who has stepped 
outside with her laptop.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss. It is finished.
choice_data_list:
Understood, I'll hold onto your social 
media device.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes.

To help Fenomeno start posting on social 
media, we provided her with her very own 
laptop.

And we made one promise: "Never search for 
reactions yourself after posting."
choice_data_list:
(All kinds of opinions are floating around 
on social media)

(It's too much of a burden for her to 
oversee everything.)

text_block_list.text:
"Because of that, after she posted 
something, I would take custody of it and 
report the reactions back to her 
afterwards."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry... To have caused you 
trouble as well, Boss.
choice_data_list: It's okay. Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
How does that sound to you? Given the 
current situation.
choice_data_list: There are all kinds of reactions, but...

text_block_list.text:
Looking at the smartphone screen, I 
relayed its contents to Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: @MenoMenon
text_block_list.text:
"Fenomeno's been pushing Golshi super hard 
lately, huh."

text_block_list.name: @Car♪rot♪
text_block_list.text:
"If Meno acknowledges her that much, maybe 
Golshi really is a good rival. We just 
haven't noticed it yet."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...! Is that so! So my words are reaching 
people too--!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...However, that is not your only opinion 
on the matter, is it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please speak your mind without 
reservation.

text_block_list.name: @Turf_Dweller
text_block_list.text:
"Fenomeno, you've gone way too soft. 
Aren't you supposed to be a champion of 
justice?!"

"‘You're an ally of justice, so act like 
one! I'm so disillusioned that you'd take 
Golshi's side!!’"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I see. Because I am "justice," you say...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Boss. Please lend me the terminal once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—The answer to the kind of ‘hero of 
justice’ I want to be.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Not just treated as a slot called "ally of 
justice." Not merely an enforcer meant to 
make those around her behave like model 
students.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What "justice" truly is. This is the way 
of being I chose after confronting it once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...What is my justice?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
They do not exist to spawn evil and then 
punish it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Denying or rejecting their existence... I 
do not believe that is grounds to judge 
the person themselves.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—It protects the future that grows through 
our very existence.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I judge wrong deeds. Not the 
person... but the dangerous actions that 
steal away people's futures."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Allies of justice exist to protect diverse 
lives and the futures born from them, and 
to bring a brighter future to the 
children.

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text:
"—That is why I ask that you not deny 
someone's very existence in the name of 
justice."

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text:
"Even without intending to take anything 
away, such denial can gouge deep—dully, 
sharply... and perhaps erase someone's 
very future."

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text:
"Please, do not seek to steal away the 
future in the name of justice."

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text: “To protect the future, please...”

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text:
"And please. Just because someone said so, 
just because those around you accept it, 
don't think you can say whatever you want. 
Don't think it's okay to hurt others—"

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text:
"Please, don't become one of those who rob 
others of their future."
(――*chime*)

"What's this? Are you implying that we 
aren't on the side of justice?"

"Even though you're the one who claimed 
you were justice and started chasing 
Golshi around."
"So now we're the bad guys, huh?"
